operads/infrastructure/typed_workflow_co: CLI orchestrates strict workflow wire parsing, typed-contract compilation and previously reviewed application compiler with native graph validation. Explicit output marks runtime_activation HOLD, native_source_binding not_attested_by_this_command and finite typed instruction graph grade. Example constructs new pinned declaration rather than repinning input. Native path not invoked; mathematical guarantees depend on underlying owners.
operads/infrastructure/workflow_loader.p: Loads declared skill signatures and sequential workflow JSON with nonempty-directory refusals. Source arity comparison accepts bool/float equal to integer length; YAML duplicate keys are accepted and wrong root type can escape typed error. Directory name supplies operation name. Delegates sequential substitution, not general DAG proof despite module wording. No garden/workflow data read by execution.
operads/application/commands/compile_lic: Thin authorization port adapter converts refusals to 422 or trusts returned normalized digest as authorized. Actual shipped HigherOperadAdapter always refuses absent a license witness, so DTO success path alone is not executable authority.
operads/application/queries/validate_wor: Thin native workflow_graph bridge propagates refusal and checks typed interface presence for valid typed outcomes, then converts list fields to tuples. Other envelope fields directly indexed/trusted; malformed envelopes can raise instead of typed refusal. No native invocation; does not itself compute topology or operadic laws.
operads/application/ports/strict_operad_: Abstract boundary for substitution colour/schema verification and licensed-term authorization. Contract only, with no implementation or certificate of mathematical law; child_ops and slot_bindings semantics depend on adapter.
operads/infrastructure/operad/higher_ope: Exact integer/non-bool slot guard plus strict native envelope/refusal/outcome/authority checks. Sends root and slot bindings; child_ops argument unused. Term authorization deliberately refuses without bound license witness. No native call run; composition is finite native metadata validation, not Python implementation of a higher operad.
operads/application/commands/compile_cat: Canonical self-delimiting operation/catalog hashes include ordered ports, lifecycle/effects/tools, document hashes and operation ownership; compiler rejects duplicate skill/operation IDs and unintended empty estates, delegates transactional persistence/idempotency. Trusts precompiled documents and source hashes, so supplied digests are not independently recomputed here. Idempotency request digest covers estate/version/allow-empty, not changing estate content, consistent only with replay semantics. Windows backslash-only path enters fallback skill ID because slash presence tested before normalization. Events use own wall clock through factory rather than injected clock. No compilation/persistence executed.
operads/domain/capability_catalog_v1.py: Closed canonical wire decoder checks duplicate/unknown keys, exact types, sorted uniqueness, dependency acyclicity, colour licence containment and domain-separated digest recomputation. Explicitly declaration/integrity only, no executor authority. Direct Skill/Agent constructors accept lists through _strings without replacing fields with tuple, allowing mutation inside frozen objects after checks. Catalog constructor verifies digest shape only; encoder verifies content digest but does not rerun member invariants. Decoder is stricter because it creates tuples and reconstructs validation. Recursive dependency walk and decode lack overall size/depth bounds. No general operad closure or executable correctness follows.
operads/tests/unit/test_capability_catal: Historical finite fixtures cover canonical encode/decode, digest tampering, licence/path refusal, missing entrypoints, tracked-vs-cache inventory, body licence nonauthority, dependency cycle and duplicate/unknown/float/noncanonical wire rejection. Real-catalog assertions fix 12 agents and >=133 skills and inspect host projections. No direct list-mutation, forged nested object resealing, or large recursion control. Not run; no public skill corpus read through compiler.
operads/tests/unit/test_domain_value_obj: Finite exact-class equality/hash, digest syntax, span ordering, lifecycle readiness and authority rank fixtures. Does not test negative multiline ending column or distinguish metadata readiness from independently verified execution. Not run.

Hand-selected boundary matrix over identifier classes, invalid scalar types, lengths, whitespace, span byte/line ordering and same-line columns, digest shape, event factories and errors. Despite fuzz label there is no generator/randomized sweep; multiline negative end_col absent. Source-only review, not fresh passing evidence.
operads/domain/events/domain_events.py: Frozen event envelopes validate ID/time/correlation/causation/authority types and recursively encode ordered collections and enum/value objects. Subclass payload counts/epochs/digests unvalidated, naive datetime allowed, schema_version unchecked, float nonfinite allowed by _event_value. create uses current wall clock independently of injected application clock. Canonical serializable dict is not canonical bytes or a verified event provenance receipt.
operads/domain/errors/domain_errors.py: Frozen typed exception records with code/message/locus/details and explicit formatting. Error names express caller predicates but do not implement invariants; frozen Exception interaction with traceback assignment may require attention only if a consumer exposes it. No exception behavior probe yet.
operads/application/dtos/api_error_dto.p: Frozen API error carrier with per-instance mutable details dict initialized when absent. No status/code validation; typed response shaping rather than a mathematical predicate.
operads/application/dtos/command_dtos.py: Frozen request carriers; CompileCatalogCommand explicitly enforces exact-bool allow_empty_estate. Remaining types/version/term/correlation fields trusted to ingress. A command is not authorization or evidence of successful compilation.
operads/application/dtos/query_dtos.py: Catalog/workflow node-edge query DTOs carry named ports, colours and optional mutable typed dict. No duplicate-ID/topology/type checking in constructors; native graph boundary owns those predicates.
operads/application/dtos/success_dtos.py: Result DTOs distinguish catalog verification, projection/signature envelopes, licence and graph reports, including duplicate IDs and typed interface. Counts/status/digest strings are producer assertions; no constructor law checks, cryptographic signature verification or graph computation.
operads/application/ports/clock_port.py: Abstract now_utc clock interface supports deterministic injection; no implementation checks timezone or monotonicity here.
operads/application/ports/estate_source_: Abstract tracked-path/raw-byte source plus optional precompiled-document hook defaulting to Ok(None). Precompiled hook can bypass Markdown parse, so source integrity depends on concrete adapter contract.
operads/application/ports/governance_cor: Read-only abstract corpus load; documentation reserves writes to apply store. No corpus loading executed or detector semantics implemented here.
operads/application/ports/id_generator_p: Abstract unique-ID interface; uniqueness is a requirement on implementation, not guaranteed by signature or optional prefix.
operads/application/ports/journal_port.p: Abstract idempotency request-digest lookup and expected-version event append. Does not implement append-only custody or concurrency isolation; downstream store must enforce them.
operads/application/ports/legacy_catalog: Abstract legacy-to-V3 estate reader returns typed documents or error. Does not guarantee semantic equivalence of legacy adaptation by declaration alone.
operads/application/ports/projection_man: Abstract catalog-to-target manifest projection, returning a string Result. Signing, exact content digest and target validity delegated to implementation.
operads/application/ports/skill_document: Abstract raw-byte-to-document parsing boundary promises losslessness. Proof of byte coverage/reconstruction belongs to parser and roundtrip tests; no parser is executed here.
operads/application/ports/unit_of_work_p: Abstract catalog lookup and atomic catalog/events/outbox/idempotency save with optional expected version. Useful transaction boundary but interface alone supplies no atomicity or multiworker proof.
